✨ codeshot | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating shareable, visually appealing images of code and terminal output for documentation, communication, or presentations.
✨ Key Features: • Converts code and terminal output to images (PNG, SVG) • Operates as a single binary with no external dependencies • Works entirely offline, ensuring privacy and security • Supports various themes, backdrops, and fonts for customization • Can output directly to a file or the clipboard
📖 Summary: Codeshot is a command-line tool written in Go that transforms code snippets, terminal output, and other text-based data into visually appealing images (PNG and SVG). It operates entirely offline as a single binary, ensuring privacy and ease of use without requiring any external services or browser interaction.
